blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —The National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) has imposed daily fines on the country’s three mobile network operators over poor mobile broadband services in parts of Metro Manila. The NTC issued show-cause orders to three mobile network operators, imposing a daily penalty of P100,000 from Sept. 25 until they resolve the service deficiencies.
